evidence.reason: The array branch snapshots every enumerable own entry, including non-index array properties, via Object.entries and Object.defineProperty. But hashInputs hashes that snapshot with canonicalJson, which serializes arrays by index only and omits such properties. Thus two inputs differing only in an enumerable non-index array property can produce the same inputsHash and a resumed run could reuse a result for a different input. This is an ordinary implementation defect, and it contradicts the function’s stated intent to reject inputs the canonical hash cannot represent losslessly.
